title: 第一卷 第30章 黄金大世将至，时间不多了！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
装饰精美的请柬上，写着一行行金色的小字，前面的内容倒也正常，无非是常规的邀请话术。

    而最后两行的内容，却让沐乾钊顿时瞪大了双眼。

    “三生阁圣主安祈雪、圣女安兮兮，与我族帝子天赐佳偶，珠联璧合。在成婚次日，将赐予二女参天造化，以太古秘法助二女成就无上圣体！”

    沐乾钊忍不住揉了揉眼睛，确认自己没有看错。

    那可是无上圣体！

    纵观整个太凰仙朝的年轻一代，都找不出一个圣体。

    姜家到底藏着怎样的手段，能将两个从下界找来的土著，提升为圣体？

    “疯了，姜家这伙人……完全是疯了！”

    “这种事，怎么可能！”

    沐乾钊完全不相信。

    但眼下，这红纸金字写着，姜家总不会拿这种事，跟各大势力的强者开玩笑吧？

    “这群疯子，他们到底想干什么……”沐乾钊已经乱了分寸，目光落在身旁的老太监身上，“魏公公，你说……他们的目的是什么？”

    “这……”魏公公愣了一下，一脸为难道，“老奴斗胆猜测，要么姜家当真掌控了提升体质的手段，要么……他们藏着更大的阴谋，像以此噱头，吸引各方势力的关注。”

    “哼，提升体质的手段并不罕见，但想要造出一尊圣体，几乎要耗尽一座不朽帝族的底蕴，他们没理由付出这么大的代价，去帮两个小世界的土著！”

    沐乾钊冷哼，沉声道：“给朕查清楚，姓安的那对姐妹到底是什么底细，还有……姜家究竟有什么目的！”

    “太凰仙朝从不落于人后，这种事……决不能这么不明不白！”

    沐乾钊咬牙切齿，眼神冰冷。

    “是……”

    魏公公连忙点头，慌慌张张的离开。

    御书房内，只剩沐乾钊看着手中的请柬，整个人陷入了沉思。

    ……

    瑶池圣地，圣心宫。

    圣女齐梦瑶正在与西王母品茶对弈，一位瑶池长老匆匆而来，隔着五彩屏风禀报：“启禀圣主、圣女，姜家的请柬到了！”

    “请柬？”西王母怔了一下，柳眉微蹙，“姜家这是又有什么喜事了？”

    言语间，她玉手轻挥，请柬飘过五彩屏风，落在了她的面前。

    当她看完里面的内容时，脸上露出了一抹饶有兴致的神色。
content_en:
The beautifully decorated invitation has lines of small golden characters written on it. The content in front of it is normal and is nothing more than conventional invitation words.

    But the content of the last two lines made Mu Qianzhao's eyes widen immediately.

    "The Holy Master of Sansheng Pavilion, An Qi Xue, and the Holy Maiden, An Xi Xi, are a perfect match with the God-given couple of our clan's emperor. On the day after their wedding, they will be bestowed with towering fortunes, and they will use ancient secret methods to help them achieve the supreme holy body!"

    Mu Qianzhao couldn't help but rub his eyes to make sure he saw it correctly.

    That is the Supreme Holy Body!

    Looking at the entire younger generation of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, there is not a single holy body that can be found.

    What kind of method does the Jiang family hide to elevate two natives brought from the lower world into holy bodies?

    "Crazy, the Jiang family...are completely crazy!"

    "How is this possible?"

    Mu Qianzhao didn't believe it at all.

    But now, what is written in gold on this red paper is that the Jiang family would never joke about this kind of thing with the powerful men of the major forces, right?

    "What do these crazy people want to do..." Mu Qianzhao was already confused and his eyes fell on the old eunuch beside him, "Eunuch Wei, tell me... what is their purpose?"

    "This..." Eunuch Wei was stunned for a moment, with a look of confusion on his face, "I dare to guess that either the Jiang family really controls the means of improving physical fitness, or... they are hiding a bigger conspiracy, using this as a gimmick to attract the attention of all parties."

    "Huh, it's not uncommon to find ways to improve one's physique, but to create a holy body would almost exhaust the resources of an immortal imperial clan. There's no reason for them to pay such a high price to help the natives of two small worlds!"

    Mu Qianzhao snorted coldly and said in a deep voice: "Find out for me the details of the sisters named An, and... what is the purpose of the Jiang family!"

    "Taihuang Immortal Dynasty never lags behind others, this kind of thing... must not be so unclear!"

    Mu Qianzhao gritted his teeth, his eyes cold.

    "Yes..."

    Eunuch Wei nodded quickly and left in a panic.

    In the imperial study room, Mu Qianzhao was the only one left looking at the invitation in his hand, and he was lost in thought.

    …

    Yaochi Holy Land, Sacred Heart Palace.

    Saint Qi Mengyao was enjoying tea and playing chess with the Queen Mother of the West. A Yaochi elder came in a hurry and reported through the colorful screen: "Holy Lord, Saint, the Jiang family's invitation has arrived!"

    "Invitation?" Queen Mother west was startled for a moment, her eyebrows furrowed slightly, "Is this another happy event for the Jiang family?"

    As she spoke, she waved her jade hand lightly, and the invitation floated across the colorful screen and landed in front of her.

    When she read the contents, a look of interest appeared on her face.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 30 The golden age is approaching and time is running out!
